First, we move all the terms to the left side of the inequality and factor:

$$
\begin{aligned}5x\cdot {7}^{2x+3}+4\cdot {7}^{2x+3} & \ge -2\cdot {7}^{2x+3} \\ 5x\cdot {7}^{2x+3}+4\cdot {7}^{2x+3}+2\cdot {7}^{2x+3} & \ge 0 \\ (5x+4+2){7}^{2x+3} & \ge 0 \\ (5x+6){7}^{2x+3} & \ge 0\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we divide both sides by ${7}^{2x+3}$ and solve the resulting inequality using familiar techniques:

$$
\begin{aligned}5x+6 & \ge 0 \\ 5x & \ge -6 \\ x & \ge -\frac{6}{5}\end{aligned}
$$

The solution to the inequality above is $x\ge -\frac{6}{5}.$
